legend: Dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate that includes follicles with reactive germinal centres (<<31773>>). CD3 highlights numerous admixed T lymphocytes (<<31770>>). CD79a stains small B cells and plasma cells (<<31771>>). CD138 is positive in large aggregates of plasma cells at the periphery of the lymphoid infiltrate and in the subepidermal compartment (<<31772>>). The plasma cells express IgG (<<31774>>) and monotypic kappa light chain (<<31775>>). Lambda light chain is negative (<<31776>>).

Presentation with a solitary red nodule on the face (<<40530>>), and a patient with multiple elevated plaques and nodules on the shoulder (<<40446>>). A rare presentation with extensive violaceous, rash-like plaques on the back that may typically be observed in epidermotropic primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma (<<40447>>).
